'''Alex Hemly''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 2nd at [[September 2000 Geneva tournament]] on 2 September 2000 with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|HDATJ]], according to Al Schaefer's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1200">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-04-geneva-illinois-9-2-00d1200/ geneva-illinois-9-2-00], DeckTech (Butt "ltkettch" Munch, 4 September 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-09-04-geneva-illinois-9-2-00d1200/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
